messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy] starting rollout: release v2.14.0 -> prod. pipeline: pipeline/prod-deploy #742. status: running stages: build -> publish -> canary.
laura: build failed on publish step, saw a 502 from registry when pushing artifact.
laura: log excerpt:
```
Uploading artifact redwood/runtime:2.14.0
error: failed to upload: PUT https://registry.internal.redwood.io/v2/… 502 Bad Gateway
checksum mismatch for layer sha256:7a3b... expected 9f4b got 3c2a
```
sam: CI worker 12 reported cache corruption on the artifact cache. I see the same checksum mismatch locally when pulling the job artifacts.
kevin: ugh. that checksum mismatch smells like a corrupted cache entry in our GCS-backed cache. can we flush the cache for that key and re-run the publish?
maya: I can flush but that will invalidate cached builds for the whole pool for ~30m. would trigger heavy rebuilds across PRs.
oliver: we should avoid a global cache flush during the release window if possible. alternative: pin to the last-known-good artifact sha and promote that instead of re-building.
kevin: do we have last-good sha?
maya: yes, candidate from yesterday: `redwood/runtime@sha256:9f3b5c4d2a1e` (passed full e2e, perf smoke).
jen: options: 1) flush cache + re-run publish -> delays and risk new flakes, 2) pin to yesterday's sha and promote -> faster but we need signoff from QA, 3) abort rollout and wait for morning change window.
laura: QA is online but oncall is out for the night. current canary is 0/3 succeeded because publish failed. nothing is live yet.
kevin: given change window, I vote for pin+promote if QA can do a quick sanity. jen can you ping QA? @jen please.
jen: pinging QA on call now. if they greenlight we'll promote pinned sha to prod canary and resume rollout. if not, we'll abort and create a follow-up.
sam: command to promote pinned image (tested locally):
```
rcli promote --image=redwood/runtime@sha256:9f3b5c4d2a1e --env=prod --strategy=canary --canary-regions=us-east-1
```
maya: deploying pinned sha to canary now (manual step).
deploy-bot: [deploy] manual promotion started by maya. job: pipeline/promote-manual #743.
jen: QA reports quick smoke ok (login, basic gen, embeddings). they saw no regression on top-level flows. :white_check_mark:
oliver: sounds good. proceed with canary. keep full monitoring and alerting on.
laura: will disable automatic cache reuse for the publish job to avoid picking corrupted layers if we re-run builds later. adding `--no-cache` to the job until we rotate the cache.
kevin: also filing an infra ticket to investigate cache corruption root cause and put TTL on those keys: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2187
jen: I'm going to pause the original automated rollout job to avoid double-promotes and update release notes: note that release uses pinned artifact due to CI publish failure; will include regression check summary.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary promotion successful: 1/1 canaries healthy in us-east-1. holding before full rollout per manual strategy.
laura: summary: publish failed because of registry 502 + checksum mismatch from corrupted cache entry. we promoted pinned sha `9f3b5c4d2a1e` to canary to unblock release. follow-ups: INFRA-2187 (investigate cache), disable cache for publish job, and run a rebuild outside change window to re-publish proper artifact.
kevin: thanks all. tagging release-manager @oliver for awareness and to decide if full rollout should wait until morning change window or continue after extended monitoring.
oliver: will monitor for an hour then decide. if no regressions we can finish rollout tonight; otherwise we'll abort to change window.
deploy-bot: [deploy] thread closed for now. manual hold engaged.
